case.description: A viral AI image from a Boredpanda article. Shows the verdict, where it was found, forensic modules and what to do next. Source: https://www.boredpanda.com/school-photos-of-celebrities-created-with-ai/
case.title: Demo 1 · AI-generated school photo of a celebrity

verdict.label: fake
verdict.headline: Fake
verdict.engine_note: Decided by Hive (commercial detector). Local detectors give the second opinion.
reasons: Hive's AI-image detector rates it 99% AI-generated — most likely made with stablediffusion.
Hive's deepfake check found no face swap (0%).
Second opinion — our local detectors agree: Uncertain (59% likely fake).
This is a screenshot of a post — we analysed the picture inside it, not the app around it.
caveats: A verdict says how the picture was made, not who made it or whether the event it shows happened.
Lower confidence because it is a screenshot (re-rendered copy).
verdict.reliability: Hive was tested here on 87 held-out images from recent AI generators and real photo sources: right 99% of the time — real photos called real 100%, fakes caught 97%.
verdict.summary: This is very likely fake (AI-generated image) — 99% likely fake.
